assertions.assertion: CPT 93229 is Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring
The diagnosis codes are R55 and I47.1
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope associated with palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
There is a need for continuous rhythm correlation during daily activities
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered to capture potential arrhythmic events
SilverBridge's letter invited the submission of this documentation
This documentation is submitted as the supporting clinical justification of medical necessity for the service
